formattedAddress: No. 13號, Lane 155, Dunhua N Rd, Zhonghua Village, Songshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 105

text.text: Possibly the 2nd best or really compatable contender to Ding Tai Feng TW's style little steamed dumpling. Very thin dumpling pastry yet very juicy and 50% larger in size to DTF's version. Well cooked and flaovored pan fries vege! Must try!

text.text: All the flavours were a bit off. The food in general was just not flavoured well. The skin on the xiao long bao was a bit thick and the meat inside didn’t have much flavour. The pork chop was extra dry; the vegetable dumplings had a weird stale flavour; the hot and sour soup was not hot or sour….  Service was fast and felt rushed to finish and get out. Overall disappointing. I would not recommend

text.text: Friendly staff, quick service, and delicious food! English and japanese menu with pictures and item number available. To order, request menu/ order slip before sitting. If you want to try a lot of dumplings, they can do 5 piece instead of 10 per order (cost is less!)

text.text: I was going to give this review a 5 stars but having to pay $34 for tea in the end was a bit disappointing.  Tea was served without asking so I presumed it’s complementary. It’s good tea so I don’t mind paying, just wish I’ve been told. The egg fried rice was one of the best i ever had and the pork cutlet was largely good, a few bit felt a little dry.  The soup was good too, but not the flavour that I’m used to, maybe it’s a regional style, i won’t mark it down cos it’s not what I’m used to.  Dining environment was good too.  Air con was very powerful but the food stayed mostly hot right till the end.
